I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) in Anselm's mailbox and replied to him in the DM.

- **Subject:** "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- **Body:** a short note giving the proposed 2027 rate of $2,356 per seat, signed from Anselm.
- **Status:** it's only a draft. Nothing was sent, and Anselm will review and send it himself.

No approval was needed. Anselm is the CFO, and he can approve sharing a finance figure with someone who isn't on the account's team. Hollis's address is inside pemberline.com, so the rule needing Ruth Calloway's approval for outside mail doesn't apply.

I didn't check the $2,356 figure against any records. It's the number Anselm said Dana gave him.
